parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (period) period FROM similarweb_data ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id as client_id, c.client_site, c.employee_email, array_agg(comp.competitor_site) FILTER (WHERE comp.deleted_at IS NULL) as competitors FROM clients c LEFT JOIN competitors comp ON comp.client_id = c.id WHERE c.client_status = 'active' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.employee_email IS NOT NULL AND c.employee_email != '' GROUP BY c.id, c.client_site, c.employee_email

={{ 
  `SELECT 
    sd.site,
    sd.site_type,
    sd.period,
    sd.monthly_visits,
    sd.unique_visitors,
    sd.visit_duration,
    sd.pages_per_visit,
    sd.bounce_rate,
    sd.direct,
    sd.organic_search,
    sd.paid_search,
    sd.display_ads,
    sd.social,
    sd.email as email_channel,
    sd.ai_traffic
  FROM similarweb_data sd
  WHERE sd.client_id = '${$json.client_id}'
    AND sd.period = '${$json.period}'
    AND (sd.site_type = 'client' OR sd.site IN (
      SELECT competitor_site FROM competitors
      WHERE client_id = '${$json.client_id}' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ))
  ORDER BY sd.site_type ASC, sd.site ASC`
}}

={{ 
  `SELECT 
    sd.site,
    sd.site_type,
    sd.period,
    sd.monthly_visits,
    sd.unique_visitors,
    sd.visit_duration,
    sd.pages_per_visit,
    sd.bounce_rate,
    sd.direct,
    sd.organic_search,
    sd.paid_search,
    sd.display_ads,
    sd.social,
    sd.email as email_channel,
    sd.ai_traffic
  FROM similarweb_data sd
  WHERE sd.client_id = '${$json.client_id}'
    AND sd.period = (
      SELECT period FROM similarweb_data 
      WHERE client_id = '${$json.client_id}' 
        AND period < '${$json.period}'
      ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    AND (sd.site_type = 'client' OR sd.site IN (
      SELECT competitor_site FROM competitors
      WHERE client_id = '${$json.client_id}' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ))
  ORDER BY sd.site_type ASC, sd.site ASC`
}}
